name: Artisan Quarter
hero_subtitle: Living craft lanes of Tetouan — leather, textiles, metalwork and the quiet rhythm of workshops.

overview.title: Where Tetouan's crafts are still made
overview.p1: Tetouan's artisan quarter is not a single monument but a web of lanes where leather, textiles, wood and metal are still worked. You hear tools before you see the shops; the pace is slower than a tourist bazaar and closer to everyday trade.
overview.p2: Start near the main medina gates and follow busy workshops rather than empty display fronts. Bargaining is normal for crafts; museum tickets and fixed-price goods are not the same game.
overview.p3: Combine a morning in the artisan lanes with Place Hassan II or a museum in the heat of the day. Carry small notes, drink water, and leave room in your bag if you plan to buy.

tips.title: Practical tips for the artisan quarter

1.title: Morning light and open doors
1.desc: Workshops are more active in the morning. Late afternoon is cooler for walking but some ateliers may close.

2.title: Bargain politely
2.desc: Craft prices are negotiable. Start below the asking price, stay friendly, and walk away if the gap is too wide — another stall is usually nearby.

3.title: Quality over quantity
3.desc: Check stitching, leather smell and dye quality. A smaller well-made piece travels better than a cheap bulk buy.

q1.question: Is the artisan quarter free to visit?
q1.answer: Yes. The lanes are public. You only pay if you buy something or join a paid workshop visit.

q2.question: Can I photograph workshops?
q2.answer: Ask before photographing people at work. Many artisans are fine with a quick shot; some prefer not.

q3.question: How long should I spend?
q3.answer: One to two hours is enough for most visitors; longer if you shop seriously.

q4.question: Is bargaining expected?
q4.answer: Yes for crafts and many souvenirs. Be polite and realistic; fixed-price shops and museums are different.

q5.question: What should I combine it with?
q5.answer: Place Hassan II, the medina walls and a museum make a solid half-day with the artisan lanes.
